frozen_sequential_boundary.policy: Storage results apply to registered one-shot unions and cannot revive a general sequential-deletion claim.

stage6a_screen.remaining_user_order: ascending SHA256 of a seed-independent public association among users exposed in the adaptation window; no Development predictions, labels, or example-count threshold are used

shared_low_rank.algorithm: exact eigendecomposition of the user-by-user Gram matrix

stage6a_screen.screen_metric: parameter relative L2 residual to the paired 200-step Exact-Masked endpoint
stage6a_screen.screen_reference: uncompressed FP32 BOTA reconstructed from the same bank
stage6a_screen.candidate_rule: A representation is eligible only if compression is at least 16x and parameter residual increases by at most 10% versus FP32 for both L8 and L4M4 in every seed. Select the eligible representation with the smallest worst-case increase, breaking ties by smaller measured bytes then canonical name.
stage6a_screen.stage6b_policy: Only the single frozen Stage 6A candidate, if one exists, may receive three-seed behavioral, utility and descriptive-MIA confirmation.

interpretation_rules: All fixed representations, hyperparameters, bank sizes, seeds and adverse results must be reported in Stage 6A.
Chunking may reduce peak memory but must report every repeated 200-step trajectory and may not be described as reducing total construction work.
Completion of a smaller bank permits advancing to the next bank size; failure to reach 16x at a mathematically incapable small K does not stop construction.
If no K=256 candidate passes the fixed screen, storage scaling fails and Stage 6B is not run.
Projected population-scale storage must remain explicitly labelled projected rather than measured.
